title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
partTitleZh: 辨識仿冒的先知性恩膏
summaryZh: 要分辨真實的先知性恩膏與猜疑的仿冒品，服事時不要承接他人的冒犯。
lines: I've got to be careful here, but just a little bit.
我要謹慎一點，但我稍微提一下。
Years ago a Satanist was converted, and a pastor was giving him a fair amount of money every month.
多年前，有一位撒但教徒信主了，有一位牧師每個月都給他一筆可觀的錢。
And a news organization found out, did some research, found out he was giving him money.
有一家新聞機構發現了，做了一些調查，發現牧師在給他錢。
So they did a big exposé to show that the pastor was funding this guy to keep his story alive that he was an ex-Satanist that was converted.
所以他們做了一篇大揭發，指出這位牧師在資助這個人，好讓他身為『歸主的前撒但教徒』這個故事能繼續流傳。
And then they reported that he lived in a condo overlooking a golf course, drove a Lincoln Continental.
然後他們報導說，他住在一個俯瞰高爾夫球場的高級公寓，開著一輛林肯大陸型轎車。
All those things were true, but they aren't true at all.
這些事都是真的，但卻也完全不是真的。
They were true in that the pastor was giving him a large amount of money,
說它是真的，是因為牧師確實給了他一大筆錢，
but it was to pay for the counseling that he needed because of the abusive environment that he grew up in.
但那是為了支付他所需的心理諮商費用，因為他在受虐的環境中長大。
He was paying for his counseling.
牧師是在為他的諮商付費。
The condo overlooking the golf course was actually an apartment.
那個俯瞰高爾夫球場的高級公寓，其實只是一般出租公寓。
The golf course was a miniature golf course.
那個高爾夫球場是一個迷你高爾夫球場。
And the Lincoln Continental was an old Lincoln covered with bumper stickers.
而那輛林肯大陸型轎車是一輛貼滿了保險桿貼紙的老舊林肯車。
It was true, but it wasn't.
那是真的，但也不是真的。
And here's what happens: both a religious spirit and political spirit want to impart the gift of suspicion.
接下來發生的事是：宗教之靈和政治之靈都想分賜『猜疑的恩賜』。
Because that reinterprets circumstances, and it causes a spirit of offense to rise up that mirrors the prophetic anointing.
因為那會重新詮釋環境，並引發一種冒犯之靈，這冒犯之靈模仿了先知性的恩膏。
這是一種仿冒品的先知性恩膏。
When you arise in a spirit of offense, it counterfeits prophetic anointing.
當你帶著冒犯之靈興起時，它就仿冒了先知性的恩膏。
You have the burning conviction, you have the sense that something needs to be done, something needs to be said,
你有著強烈的信念，你覺得有些事必須去做，有些話必須去說，
but not recognizing that the origin of the information is actually the spirit of deception, the gift of suspicion gets imparted.
但卻沒認出這資訊的源頭其實是欺騙之靈，猜疑的恩賜就這樣被分賜下來了。
You can hear information and be righteously stirred up, not realizing you were given wrong information, even though your conviction is correct.
你聽到了資訊，並被激發出公義的憤慨，卻沒意識到你得到的是錯誤的資訊，儘管你的信念是正確的。
And what do they say? "Whatever you misdiagnose, you will mistreat."
俗話說什麼：「你誤診了什麼，就會錯誤地治療。」
I have experiences now and then that I don't ever bring to you,
我偶爾會有一些經歷，是我從來沒有跟你們提過的，
but I get off the airplane here in Redding, and somebody's just standing there just cursing me.
我會在這裡（雷丁市）下飛機，就有個人站在那裡咒罵我。
Christian curses, of course. Cursing me.
當然是基督徒式的咒罵。咒罵我。
Why? Well, probably they believed something they saw on YouTube,
為什麼？嗯，可能他們相信了在 YouTube 上看到的東西，
or they believed a bad report from somebody.
或是聽信了某人的負面報告。
雙方之間從來沒有過對話。
Is their conviction correct? It probably is.
他們的信念正確嗎？可能正確。
It's just their information is wrong.
I look at them and I see they have a conviction for the Lord.
我看著他們，我看到他們對主有著堅定的信念。
They are making what they think is a righteous stand, but somebody fed them a lie that they believed.
他們正在採取他們自認為公義的立場，但有人餵給他們一個謊言，而他們相信了。
Wow, or they just don't like me, could be that too.
哇，或者他們就是不喜歡我，也有可能是這樣。
I don't know, can't be that.
我不知道，不可能是那樣。
The point is that to be a prophetically discerning people, we have to be able to recognize the difference between the true prophetic anointing and the counterfeit,
重點是，要成為一個具有先知性辨別力的子民，我們必須能夠認出真實的先知性恩膏和仿冒品之間的差別，
which is suspicious, it's agenda-driven, and it moves in the spirit of offense.
這仿冒品充滿猜疑，它是受議程驅使的，並且在冒犯之靈裡運行。
One of the biggest challenges in life is to not pick up the offenses of the people you love and serve.
人生中最大的挑戰之一，就是不要承接你所愛和服事之人的冒犯。
If you give yourself to the poor, it's very hard to not be offended at the rich.
如果你獻身服事窮人，你就很難不對富人感到冒犯。
If you have been called to serve the wealthy, it's very hard to serve them well without being offended at those who don't work.
如果你蒙召服事富人，你就很難在好好服事他們的同時，不對那些不工作的人感到冒犯。
If you minister to college students, it's very difficult for you to minister to them without being offended at conservative political groups.
如果你服事大學生，你就很難在服事他們的同時，不對保守派政治團體感到冒犯。
If you minister to the old, it's very hard for you to do that well without being offended at the young.
如果你服事年長者，你就很難在好好服事他們的同時，不對年輕人感到冒犯。
The list goes on and on and on.
這個清單可以一直列下去。
If you minister to the Native Americans, First Nations people, it's very hard to do that well without picking up an offense towards those who have obviously mistreated them.
如果你服事美洲原住民、第一民族的人，你就很難在好好服事他們的同時，不對那些明顯虧待過他們的人產生冒犯。
The point is, your effectiveness and my effectiveness is in some way restrained and restricted by how well can we serve people and love them well,
重點是，你我的效能在某種程度上會受到限制和約束，取決於我們能在多大程度上好好服事並愛人，
and bring the word of the Lord for this moment for their benefit, not ours, not for our agenda, not for our identity, for their benefit entirely, without picking up any offense that they may have.
並在這個時刻為著他們的益處帶出神的話語，不是為了我們，不是為了我們的議程，也不是為了我們的身分認同，完全是為了他們的益處，而不沾染任何他們可能帶有的冒犯。
And the depth at which we get to go in the anointing to impact the course of history and affect culture is in many ways determined by how well we can navigate this thing without being offended.
我們在恩膏中能進入的深度，以至於能影響歷史進程和影響文化，在許多方面取決於我們能在多大程度上妥善駕馭這件事而不被冒犯。
